Davide Frattesi to miss Italy’s Nations League clash with Belgium
 Italy has missed the last three World Cups but lead the four-team Group A1, ahead of France, thanks to their superior head-to-head record with Les Bleus, who also have 10 points from five matches.

 Italian midfielder Davide Frattesi celebrates scoring his team's second goal in the UEFA Nations League match between Italy and France at San Siro Stadium in Milan.
 | Photo Credit: AFP
 Italian midfielder Davide Frattesi celebrates scoring his team's second goal in the UEFA Nations League match between Italy and France at San Siro Stadium in Milan.
 | Photo Credit: AFP
 Davide Frattesi will miss Italy’s final Nations League group match against Belgium after an injury forced the midfielder to leave the Azzurri camp on Friday.
 The Italian Football Federation (FIGC) said that Frattesi, a goalscorer in Italy’s 3-1 win over France on Thursday, has an unspecified “muscular issue” and will return to his club, Lazio.
 ALSO READ: Carlo Ancelotti looks to Brazil’s future in Japan rematch 
 Italy has missed the last three World Cups but lead the four-team Group A1, ahead of France, thanks to their superior head-to-head record with Les Bleus, who also have 10 points from five matches.
 A draw against Belgium in Brussels on Sunday would be enough to send Italy to the quarter-finals of the competition.
